knownIssues.description: CDP fill(uid, '') to clear the search input to empty string did not update the DOM input value or trigger React onChange (input, URL, and list state all stayed on the previous non-empty query). Clearing via click + Ctrl+A + Backspace worked correctly and immediately restored the 42-person list. Root-cause is almost certainly the fill-tool's handling of empty-string values on this controlled input, not an app defect — Ctrl+A/Backspace is the reliable path for POM 'clear search' actions on this page.

apps/mira-work/i18n/messages/en/agent.json contact.import namespace has several mojibake-corrupted strings (e.g. continuing: 'Uploading��', parseSubtitle: 'This usually takes 5�C30 seconds', candidateCount uses '��' instead of '·'). These keys drive the in-progress/parsing/preview steps of the Import flow, which were NOT triggered during this smoke pass (no file was uploaded, per task instructions). Flagging for a follow-up targeted pass through the full import flow to confirm whether the corruption reaches rendered UI.
